scope: Research-only cost-aware comparison. No real-money authorization.

bonoloto.note: Two-formula diversified subset preserves one historical full hit plus one near hit at very low theoretical cost, but has not reproduced a 5/6 or 6/6 in 2026.

euromillones.note: Current evidence does not justify large panels; future work should aim to compress to 1-2 complete tickets including stars.

eurodreams.note: Previous clean pre-2026 selection did not preserve the retrospective 5/6 signal.

gordo-primitiva.note: Triplet-frequency anomaly improved some intermediate metrics but did not produce profitable official holdout economics.

decision: Continue research. Preserve Bonoloto 25-ticket and 2-ticket frozen shadows for matched prospective comparison. Do not infer a profitable edge before official settlement and repeated future evidence.
